work.author: Jacques-Paul Migne
work.description: The thirtieth volume of Migne's Latin series, printed at Paris in 1846 as the eleventh volume of Jerome, holding works transmitted under Jerome's name including the Liber Comitis, the Roman lectionary list whose Sunday series runs at cols. 487-532. A locus is the printed column number.
